sentences.text:
THESE APPEALS COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT, THIS DAY, THE FOLLOWING ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the Appellant/Insurance Company in MFA No.200663/2017 along with its representative and the learned Counsel for Appellant/Claimant in MFA No.200927/2017 are present.
Chidambaraya S/O Shantappa vs Parameshwar S/O Shivaputrappa Biradar ...

on 16 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63575361/
2 2.
After prolonged negotiations, the MFA No.200663/2017 filed by United India Insurance Company Limited and MFA No.200927/2017 filed by the Appellant/Claimant are settled.
As per the settlement arrived at between the parties, both the parties have agreed to withdraw the aforesaid appeals.

It is further agreed by the United India Insurance Company Limited that it has already deposited a total sum of Rs.1,86,520/- (Rs.1,61,520/-
& Rs.25,000/-) and has agreed to deposit the remaining amount of Rs.1,49,780/- (Rupees One Lakh Forty Nine Thousand Seven Hundred Eighty only) before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of preparation of Award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at the rate of 9% p.a.
from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to that effect.
Same is accepted.
3. The entire amount shall be released in favour of the Claimant.
4. The amount in deposit, if any to be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith.
